newsitem.title: USA: Sulzer Medica says FDA okays Res-Q Micron.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer Medica says FDA okays Res-Q Micron.

text.p: Sulzer Medica, an operating group of Sulzer AG, said on Monday that it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market a new implantable cardioverter-defibrillator.

The company's cardiac arrhythmia management business, Sulzer Intermedica, designed the Res-Q Micron implantable cardioverter-defibrillator arrhythmia management device to prevent sudden cardiac death.

Sulzer Medica, one of five operating groups of the Swiss-based Sulzer LTD, is a partnership of companies focused on the development of implantable medical devices and biomaterials for the cardiovascular and orthopedic markets.
